```{r}


files <- list.files(path = "/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/09152025")

robo<- data.frame()

for (file in files){
  name <- gsub(".csv","", file)
  robo_file <- read_csv(paste("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/09152025/",file, sep = ""))

  robo_file$sensor <- name
  robo <- rbind(robo, robo_file)
}

colnames(robo) <- c("datetime", "temp", "robo_sensor")

```


```{r}
robo_sensor_key <- read_excel("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/robo_sensor_key_post08072025.xlsx")
robo_sensor_key$robo_sensor <- as.character(robo_sensor_key$robo_sensor)
robo$robo_sensor <- as.character(robo$robo_sensor)
robo$temp <- as.numeric(robo$temp)

robo <- left_join(robo, robo_sensor_key, by = "robo_sensor")
robo$bag <- as.factor(robo$bag)

robo$datetime <- as.POSIXct(robo$datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", tz = "America/Los_Angeles")

robo$datetime <- robo$datetime - hours(7)

```

### Interpolate temps where sensors were offset 
```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(zoo)

# Define your reference and comparison sensors
ref_sensor_id <- "oyster_2"
other_sensors <- c("oyster_6", "oyster_7", "oyster_8")

# Step 1: Get the reference sensor data
sensor_ref <- robo %>%
  filter(robo_sensor == ref_sensor_id) %>%
  arrange(datetime) %>%
  select(datetime, temp) 

# Step 2: Interpolate each comparison sensor to reference timestamps
interpolated_matrix <- sapply(other_sensors, function(sensor_id) {
  sensor_target <- robo %>%
    filter(robo_sensor == sensor_id) %>%
    arrange(datetime)
  
  z <- zoo(sensor_target$temp, sensor_target$datetime)
  na.approx(z, xout = sensor_ref$datetime)
})


long_interp <- imap_dfr(interpolated_matrix, function(zoo_obj, sensor_name) {
  tibble(
    datetime = index(zoo_obj),
    interpolated_temp = coredata(zoo_obj),
    oyster_id = sensor_name
  )
})

colnames(long_interp) <- c("datetime", "temp", "robo_sensor")

long_interp <- left_join(long_interp, robo_sensor_key, by = "robo_sensor")
long_interp$bag <- as.factor(long_interp$bag)

```


### Add interpolated temps in, take uninterped ones out
```{r}
robo_filtered <- robo %>%
  filter(!robo_sensor %in% c("oyster_6", "oyster_7", "oyster_8"))

robo_interp <- bind_rows(robo_filtered, long_interp)
write.csv(robo_interp, "/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/09152025/interp_comb.csv")

```

### combine interp files
```{r}
interp1 <- read.csv("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/07102025/interp_comb.csv")
interp2 <- read.csv("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/08062025/interp_comb.csv")
interp3 <- read.csv("/Users/graceleuchtenberger/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Documents/Density_field/data/Robo/09152025/interp_comb.csv")

interp <- bind_rows(interp1, interp2, interp3)

interp$datetime <- as.POSIXct(interp$datetime, format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")

```



```{r}
robo_interp_mean <- interp %>%
  group_by(datetime, density, tide, top_bottom) %>%
  summarize(mean_temp = mean(temp))
```



```{r}
robo_interp_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "H")%>%
  filter(density == "D")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=mean_temp, colour = top_bottom))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```


```{r}
robo_interp_mean %>%
  filter(tide == "L")%>%
  filter(density == "D")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime, y=mean_temp, colour = top_bottom))+
  geom_line()+
  theme_classic()
```

```{r}
robo_mean_wide <- robo_interp_mean %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = c(density, top_bottom), values_from = mean_temp)

# Calculate differences
temp_diff <- robo_mean_wide %>%
  group_by(tide)%>%
  mutate(D_diff = D_2- D_1,
         top_diff = D_2 - S_1,
         C_diff = C_SC - C_DC) 
```


```{r}
temp_diff %>%
  filter(tide == "L")%>%
  ggplot(aes(x=datetime))+
  geom_line(aes(y=D_diff), color = "tomato")+
  geom_line(aes(y=top_diff), color = "gold")+
  #geom_line(aes(y = C_diff), color = "steelblue")+
  theme_classic()
```
